data.name: Chukwudi
data.gender_notes: Chukwudi is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Chukwudi is recorded in name-lists as “God is sufficient”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chukwudi expresses “God is sufficient”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chukwudi total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
